responses.description: Theatre Peckham is an award-winning cultural venue for artistic excellence and social change. From our south-east London home, we provide training opportunities for aspiring artists, amplifying young voices and inspiring creativity and ambition.

links.text: Edinburgh Fringe Previews at Canada Water Theatre
The Alex Wheatle Witness Writing Project
WE MOVE: Holiday Dance Camps for girls
The Edinburgh Fringe comes to Canada Water Theatre this Summer, with Previews of 9 unmissable shows!

Got a story to tell? This is your chance to write it. This autumn we're launching a new scriptwriting programme for 10 Young Black creatives aged 17–30* ready to develop their voice, sharpen their storytelling and explore writing for the stage.

We deliver exceptional performing arts training that nurtures a love for creativity through self-expression, teamwork, and play, building confidence and providing a clear pathway into the creative industries. 2026/27 registration now open!

<h1 id="welcome-to-theatre-peckham" class="wp-block-heading">Welcome to Theatre Peckham</h1>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Theatre Peckham is a multi-award-winning cultural venue that has been championing artistic excellence and social change since 1986. In 2026, we proudly celebrate 40 years of Theatre Peckham, and we invite our community to celebrate with us.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">From our south-east London home, we provide training opportunities for aspiring artists, amplifying young voices and inspiring creativity and ambition.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Our 200-seat theatre at Theatre Peckham and 150-seat theatre at Canada Water Theatre proudly platform a diverse range of productions that reflect the experiences of our community, from groundbreaking original performances to innovative adaptations.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">As a charity, we are building a world where everyone can participate in, lead, work in and enjoy creativity and culture. Theatre Peckham venues are a dynamic space for creativity and connection.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Join us in celebrating the transformative power of theatre so we can have 40 more years and more.</p>
